list.title: What is CGPA?
list.content: CGPA stands for Cumulative Grade Point Average. It is used to measure a student's academic performance.

list.title: How CGPA is Calculated?
list.content: CGPA is calculated by taking the weighted average of the grade points based on the credit hours of each course. For instance, if a student has three courses where the first is 2 credits with a grade point of 4.00, the second is 1 credit with a grade point of 3.75, and the third is 3 credits with a grade point of 3.75, then the CGPA would be (2×4.00 + 1×3.75 + 3×3.75) divided by the total credits (2+1+3), resulting in a CGPA of 3.83.

list.title: My CGPA is not displaying correctly
list.content: This may happen if you have not completed all your courses or if there are pending evaluations or all credit results were not fetched. Kindly check completed credits and grades.

list.title: What is the difference between SGPA and CGPA?
list.content: SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) is the average of grade points earned in a semester, while CGPA is the cumulative average of all semesters.
